draftBody:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for reaching out to the Panzi Foundation and for sharing such a detailed overview of AHDL Humanitary's work. The programs you describe — protecting children and women from trafficking, sexual exploitation, and violence across the East Africa Community, including eastern DRC — reflect a commitment that we deeply respect.

We have received your proposal and will share it with the relevant members of our team for internal review. We want to be transparent that we are not in a position to make any commitments at this stage, as our current priorities and resources are focused on our existing programs and partnerships.

We appreciate you taking the time to connect with us, and we will follow up if there is an opportunity to explore further.

With gratitude,
The Panzi Foundation Team
